prompt:
Image 1 is the camera and pose guide: a grey clay maquette rendered from the game's battle camera, with the moss along its back painted in the god's colour. Copy from it exactly the camera angle, the direction the beast faces, its pose, and its size and place in the frame. Do not copy its smooth clay surfaces, its simplified shapes or the thickness of its limbs: the anatomy, the face and every ornament follow Image 2 and the description.
Image 2 is this god's own approved painted portrait: paint the same beast, with the same shapes, colours, materials and marks, now seen full length from above at the battle camera, in the same painting style. Do not copy its dark background, its candlelight or its framing.

One large painted beast, full length, alone in the image on a perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, as a game cutout. Pose: crawling low at rest like a giant lizard: its belly a hand's breadth above the ground, its short, powerful legs splayed out to the sides, its thick neck carried low and forward and its head held level and a little raised, jaws closed, the long heavy tail curving behind it.

Camera: high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees, the way a player looks down at a miniature on a table; orthographic, with no perspective. The beast faces toward us and toward the lower left of the image: we see its head and face from above, its chest and its left flank. It is foreshortened as seen from above: its back and head are large, its legs short.

Light: outdoor daylight; the beast stays as dark and as muted as in its portrait, lit only by small warm and cool highlights, never washed out or brightened. A high sun in the upper left of the image lights the top of the head, the upper surfaces and the upper-left side of the beast with warm highlights; a cool blue-grey sky fill lies in the shadows on the lower-right side. No candlelight, no dramatic dark shadows, nothing glows unless the description below says so. No cast shadow on the background.

Painting style: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, moderate detail, the same hand as the painted portrait; a muted earthy palette with the god's own colours as its portrait shows them, in which the moss along its back in deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour is the one clear hue; soft painterly edges, with small crisp highlights on metal edges and a thin bright rim of light along the upper-left edges of the beast. The beast has a strong, simple, readable silhouette that still reads when it is shrunk to 120 pixels tall. It is not a cartoon: no cel shading, no thick black outlines, no chibi or big-headed proportions, no glossy 3D render, no pixel art.

The god: the Elder Wyrm, a colossal wingless dragon-god that never flies: slow, vast and regenerating, it tramples whatever is small. Colours: muted and earthy. The one clear colour of the beast is the moss along its back: deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade, clearly coloured, never grey, slate, olive or yellow-green (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour. Nothing in the image glows: no fire, no smoke, the jaws are closed. No other saturated area larger than a small clasp or trim.
Body: a long, heavy, low-slung four-legged dragon built like a giant salamander, about three times as long as it is tall, with no wings at all, a long thick neck and a long heavy tail; scales of bronze-brown (#8A6A3E) in broad bands, a paler bronze belly of broad plates. Head: a broad, heavy head with a deep jaw, closed, and dark amber eyes. Horns: a crown of spines: a ring of long sharp spines rising around the back of the head. Back: a thick mantle of moss grows along its spine from the neck to the tail, deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade, clearly coloured, never grey, slate, olive or yellow-green (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour. Tail: a heavy tail ending in a bony club. It has no wings.

Size: the beast fills about 86% of the image along its longest side, placed as in Image 1, with at least 24 pixels of clean background all around; nothing is cropped.

Background: one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor, vignette or shadow. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the figure: no pink cloth, no pink glow, no pink reflections; its greens stay green.

Never: text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, frames, signatures, logos; a floor, ground, scenery or cast shadows; blood; other creatures or people; a cropped figure; smoke, flames, sparks, floating embers or mist.
